paragraphs: Biohaven is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of life-changing treatments in key therapeutic areas, including immunology, neuroscience, and oncology. We are advancing our innovative portfolio of therapeutics, leveraging our proven drug development experience and multiple proprietary drug development platforms.

On October 3, 2022, Biohaven Pharmaceutical Holding Company Ltd. (the "Former Parent") completed the distribution to holders of its common shares of all of our outstanding common shares and the spin-off of Biohaven Ltd. from the Former Parent (the "Separation"). As a result of the Separation, Biohaven became an independent, publicly traded company as of October 3, 2022, and commenced regular way trading under the symbol "BHVN"' on the New York Stock Exchange on October 4, 2022.

In the fourth quarter of 2025, we initiated strategic portfolio and cost-optimization measures to prioritize three key, late-stage, clinical programs that we believe have the greatest potential for value generation. Our key clinical programs include Kv7 ion channel modulation for epilepsy; Molecular Degrader of Extracellular Proteins ("MoDE") and Targeted Removal of Aberrant Protein ("TRAP") extracellular protein degradation for immunological diseases; and myostatin-activin pathway targeting agent for neuromuscular and metabolic diseases, including obesity (collectively, the "key programs"). The product candidates chart below summarizes our most advanced programs, including those that are key clinical stage programs and some of our preclinical programs that are beginning to advance to the clinic.
The following table summarizes our programs for our product candidates. We hold the worldwide rights to substantially all of our product candidates.

Biohaven Molecular Degrader of Extracellular Protein ("MoDE") and Targeted Removal of Aberrant Protein ("TRAP"™) degraders harness selectivity, rapidity and patient-friendly self-administration to remove disease-causing proteins from the body to potentially treat a range of diseases. Each MoDE or TRAP degrader is a novel bispecific molecule that targets a specific form of disease-causing circulating protein and directs it to the liver for degradation by the endosomal/lysosomal pathway. The first extracellular protein degraders in the clinic, three MoDE and TRAP degraders have now been dosed in Phase 1 trials. Our lead MoDE, BHV-1300, has demonstrated deep lowering of IgG > 80% in Phase 1 clinical trials and is being developed as a proprietary subcutaneous formulation in conjunction with an autoinjector for easy-to-use self-administration. Data in the first Graves' patient dosed with BHV-1300 demonstrated complete suppression of autoantibodies targeting the TSH receptor and normalization of T3 and T4 within one month of dosing. We plan to initiate a pivotal trial in 2026.

BHV-1400 , Biohaven's first TRAP molecule, is designed to specifically target the pathogenic driver of IgAN, galactose deficient IgA1 (Gd-IgA1) without suppressing the healthy immune system. BHV-1400 has been dosed in a clinically concluded phase 1 study in normal healthy volunteers and continues to be dosed in an expansion cohort of IgAN patients with plans to initiate the pivotal study in IgAN patients in 2026. Data from the first, and lowest, dose cohort of BHV-1400 demonstrated clear differentiation from competitors in the IgA nephropathy space, with deep, rapid lowering of Gd-IgA1 within hours and preservation of host immunoglobulins ("Ig") including IgG, IgA, IgE, and IgM. These results have now been re-capitulated in the first IgAN patients dosed, with improvements noted in hematuria, proteinuria, and eGFR within the first month of dosing.

BHV-1300 has demonstrated deep lowering of IgG1, 2 and 4 in Phase 1 clinical trials and is being developed as a proprietary subcutaneous formulation in conjunction with an autoinjector for easy-to-use self-administration. BHV-1300 was rationally designed to spare IgG3, potentially allowing for preservation of host defense. BHV-1300 is being developed for the treatment of common immune mediated-diseases, such as Graves' Disease and Rheumatoid Arthritis ("RA"). Graves' Disease is a disease in which IgG1 autoantibodies stimulate the thyroid to produce excess thyroid hormone. Targeted removal of disease-causing IgG has the potential to eliminate the pathogenic thyroid-stimulating antibody and modify the disease. Graves' Disease is estimated to impact 1% of the population globally. RA is a chronic autoimmune disease estimated to affect 1 to 2% of the global population. RA primarily affects the joints, causing pain, swelling, stiffness, and loss of function.

We evaluated the effect of single and multiple doses of BHV-1300 in cynomolgus monkeys. In September 2023, we reported data from confirmatory studies that showed a 75-80% reduction of IgG levels two days after a single dose and over 90% of IgG lowering after three doses.

Maximal lowering across FcRn inhibitors is 60-80% within approximately 7 to 21 days after initiation of single or multiple doses, respectively, in cynomolgus. In contrast, a single dose of BHV-1300 lowers IgG by approximately 75 to 80% after approximately 2 days, and after three rapid doses to greater than 90% lowering. The length of significant exposure to BHV-1300 is approximately one day within the dosage interval compared to continuous exposure required of the FcRn inhibitors. Mechanism-related liabilities of FcRn inhibitors seen in animals and humans, including hypoalbuminemia and hypercholeresterolemia, are not expected and do not occur with BHV-1300 in cynomolgus. See figures below comparing the speed and depth of lowering to FcRn inhibitors.

In January 2024, we reported preclinical pharmacodynamic single dose data with BHV-1300 which demonstrated the Biohaven IgG degrader technology allows for co-administration with Fc-containing biologics. The PK of Humira® was unaltered after being dosed 12 hours after BHV-1300 administration (see figure below).
* Adapted from BLA 761154, IND 116471, Study no. r-fkb327-01 Our Phase 1 Study with BHV-1300

The Phase 1 SAD study examining BHV-1300 in healthy subjects was initiated in the first quarter of 2024. In May 2024, we reported preliminary results from our Phase 1 study of BHV-1300. These results in healthy subjects demonstrated that BHV-1300 rapidly and selectively lowers IgG in a dose-dependent manner in the first 4 cohorts completed to date (see figure below). Preliminary IgG lowering data was consistent with modeling, with dose- and time-dependent IgG lowering observed even in initial low-dose cohorts. Some subjects experienced IgG reductions as low as 50 to 70% of baseline. BHV-1300 demonstrated reduction of IgG without significantly impacting LFTs, albumin, LDL cholesterol or other serum labs. BHV-1300 has been safe and well tolerated to date, with no serious or severe adverse events. Most adverse events ("AEs") were mild, deemed unrelated to study drug and resolved spontaneously. As expected from the selectivity of the molecule for IgG, when compared to placebo, there were no meaningful reductions in average IgA, IgM or IgE levels during the week after dosing. No adverse trends have been observed in vital signs or ECGs. Modeling suggested additional cohorts in the Phase 1 study would achieve greater than 70% lowering of IgG utilizing doses compatible with subcutaneous administration.

The Phase 1 study has also compared intravenous and subcutaneous administration of BHV-1300. Subcutaneous administration of BHV-1300 demonstrated an average of approximately 44% higher than expected exposure compared to the dose-equivalent intravenous formulation without injection site reactions. This new human data confirms the feasibility of our plan for convenient dosing of BHV-1300 with a patient self-administered subcutaneous autoinjector.

In the fourth quarter of 2024 we provided an update to our Phase 1 study of BHV-1300, reporting that subcutaneously administered BHV-1300 achieved deep lowering of targeted IgG (IgG1, IgG2, IgG4, over IgG3), with reductions over 60% in the lowest subcutaneous dose tested in the ongoing MAD study. Subcutaneous BHV-1300 achieved progressive reduction in IgG within hours of each weekly dose administration in the MAD, and pharmacodynamic effects were sustained relative to baseline over the four-week study period. BHV-1300 has been safe and well-tolerated across the Phase 1 study. There were no clinically significant effects on albumin or liver function, and no increases in cholesterol were noted. Further enhancing the competitive safety profile and as intentionally designed, plasma IgG3 levels were preserved through the end of study week 4 to allow for healthy immune effector functioning. All AEs were mild, any drug-related AE resolved, and there were no discontinuations due to study drug related AEs. The optimized subcutaneous formulation in the MAD also showed substantially less inter-patient variability compared to previously reported intravenous BHV-1300. In addition, we announced that we entered into an agreement with Ypsomed to develop and manufacture BHV-1300 in an easy-to-use, autoinjector for self-administration intended for commercialization.

paragraphs: In connection with any investment decision with respect to our securities, you should carefully consider the risks described below, as well as general economic and business risks and the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and in our other filings with the SEC. The occurrence of any of the events or circumstances described below or other adverse events could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition and could cause the trading price of our common shares to decline. Additional risks or uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also harm our business.

An investment in our common shares is subject to a number of risks, including risks related to our product candidates, risks related to our business and risks related to our common shares. The following list of risk factors is not exhaustive. Please read the information in this section captioned "1A. Risk Factors" for a more thorough description of these and other risks.
•We have a limited operating history, have incurred significant operating losses since inception and anticipate that we will continue to incur substantial operating losses for the foreseeable future.

•Deterioration in general economic conditions in the United States and globally, including the effect of prolonged periods of inflation on our suppliers, third-party service providers and potential partners, may have a negative impact on our business and results of operations.
•An inability to raise capital when needed or on terms favorable to us could force us to curtail our planned operations and growth strategy.
•Credit risk with respect to our investments or the financial institutions at which we deposit funds could adversely affect us.

We are a biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of life-changing treatments in key therapeutic areas, including immunology, neuroscience, and oncology. We are advancing our innovative portfolio of therapeutics, leveraging our proven drug development experience and multiple proprietary drug development platforms. In the fourth quarter of 2025, we initiated a strategic reprioritization of our clinical development programs are now focused on three key areas to prioritize resources. Our key clinical programs include Kv7 ion channel modulation for epilepsy; Molecular Degrader of Extracellular Proteins ("MoDE") and Targeted Removal of Aberrant Protein ("TRAP") extracellular protein degradation for immunological diseases; and myostatin-activin pathway targeting agent for neuromuscular and metabolic diseases, including obesity (collectively, the "key programs").
For a full discussion of our programs, including recent developments, refer to "Item 1. Business" included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

On October 3, 2022, the Former Parent completed the Separation from Biohaven Ltd. As a result of the Separation, Biohaven Ltd. became an independent, publicly traded company as of October 3, 2022, and commenced regular way trading under the symbol "BHVN" on the NYSE on October 4, 2022.
Biohaven is a British Virgin Islands ("BVI") corporation and was a wholly owned subsidiary of the Former Parent prior to the Separation.

We had entered into a Distribution Agreement and various other agreements relating to transition services, licenses and certain other matters with the Former Parent. These agreements govern our relationship with the Former Parent and include the allocation of employee benefits, taxes and certain other liabilities and obligations attributable to periods prior to, at and after the Separation. For additional information regarding these agreements, see Note 14, "Related Party Transactions," of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements appearing elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

The following is a summary of key developments affecting our business in 2025 (excluding updates to our programs, which are discussed in "Item 1. Business" included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K):

On April 28, 2025 (the "Closing Date"), the Company and certain of its subsidiaries entered into a Note Purchase Agreement (the "Note Purchase Agreement" or "NPA"), by and among Biohaven Therapeutics Ltd., as issuer (the "Issuer"), the Company and certain subsidiaries of the Company, as obligors (together with the Issuer, the "Obligors"), the purchasers party thereto (the "Purchasers") and Beetlejuice SA LLC, an affiliate of Oberland Capital Management LLC ("Oberland"), as purchaser agent (the "Purchaser Agent"). Pursuant to the Note Purchase Agreement, the Purchasers agreed to purchase senior secured notes from the Issuer (i) subject to the satisfaction of certain customary closing conditions, in an initial tranche shortly after the Closing Date for an aggregate purchase price of $250 million (the "First Notes") and (ii) subject to the satisfaction of certain conditions, including the receipt of approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (the "FDA") for troriluzole, in a second tranche in up to three purchases on or before June 30, 2026 for an aggregate purchase price of $150 million (the "Second Notes"). The proceeds from the sale of the First Notes and the Second Notes may be used for working capital and permitted business purposes. The Issuer may also sell to the Purchasers, at the Issuer's option and subject to the approval of each Purchaser agreeing to participate therein, in its sole discretion, additional notes in up to four purchases for an aggregate purchase price of $200 million (the "Third Notes" and, together with the First Notes and the Second Notes, the "Notes"), the proceeds of which may be used solely to fund
permitted acquisitions and related costs and expenses. We received approximately $250 million in proceeds from the sale of the First Notes in April 2025.

The Purchasers will be entitled to receive payments (the "Revenue Payments") equal to, initially, 6.25% of the global net sales of troriluzole ("Net Sales"), which will increase pro rata upon the purchase of any of the Second Notes. If the aggregate amount of Revenue Payments (if troriluzole has received FDA approval) and any Milestone Payment (as defined below) made by the Issuer to the Purchasers pursuant to the Note Purchase Agreement as of December 31, 2030 (the "Test Date") equals or exceeds the amount of the aggregate purchase price for the Notes paid by the Purchasers (the "Total Funded Amount") to the Issuer pursuant to the Note Purchase Agreement (the "Test Date Condition"), the then-applicable percentage of Net Sales payable as Revenue Payments will automatically decrease by 60% for all subsequent years. If the Test Date Condition is not satisfied by the Test Date, the then-applicable percentage of Net Sales payable as Revenue Payments will automatically increase for all subsequent years to the lesser of (i) a rate that would have provided the Purchasers with 100% of the Total Funded Amount as of the Test Date had such rate applied from the Closing Date through and including the Test Date and (ii) 80%. The Revenue Payments will become payable to the Purchasers on a quarterly basis after the Closing Date.

The Issuer will also be obligated to pay to the Purchasers a milestone payment (the "Milestone Payment") equal to 35% of the Funded Amount upon the approval by the FDA or European Medicines Agency ("EMA") of troriluzole or other Company products. The Milestone Payment will be payable in equal quarterly installments starting in the quarter after the approval is received or, if the Milestone Payment is earned after the Test Date, in one single payment on the 10th Business Day after the date the approval is received.

In addition to the Revenue Payments and the Milestone Payment discussed above, if the Test Date Condition is not satisfied, then the Company will be obligated to make a one-time payment to the Purchasers equal to 100% of the Total Funded Amount as of the Test Date less the aggregate Revenue Payments and Milestone Payments made to the Purchasers as of the Test Date (the "True-Up Payment"). If troriluzole has not received FDA approval for the treatment of obsessive compulsive disorder or spinocerebellar ataxia as of the Test Date, any Milestone Payments shall be excluded in calculating the True-Up Payment.

The Purchasers' right to receive the Revenue Payments shall terminate on the date on which the Purchasers have received Revenue Payments and Milestone Payments (the "Total Payments"), together with any True-Up Payment paid by the Issuer to the Purchasers, in an aggregate amount equal to the then-applicable Cap Amount, unless the Note Purchase Agreement is terminated prior to such date. The "Cap Amount" means an amount equal to the Total Funded Amount multiplied by (x) on or prior to the earlier of the Test Date and the date the Test Date Condition is satisfied, 1.65 with respect to the Second Notes and 1.95 with respect to the First Notes and any Third Notes, and (y) after the earlier of the Test Date and the date the Test Date Condition is satisfied, (a) with respect to the First Notes and Third Notes, (i) if the Test Date Condition is satisfied, 1.60, (ii) if the Test Date Condition is not satisfied and the Total Payments as of the Test Date are equal to or greater than 90% of the Total Funded Amount, 1.80, (iii) if the Test Date Condition is not satisfied and the Total Payments as of the Test Date are less than 90% but equal to or greater than 50% of the Total Funded Amount, 1.95, (iv) if the Test Date Condition is not satisfied and the Total Payments as of the Test Date are less than 50% of the Total Funded Amount, 2.10 if on or prior to the 8th anniversary of the Closing Date and 2.25 if after the 8th anniversary of the Closing Date, and (b) with respect to the Second Notes, (i) if the Test Date Condition is satisfied, 1.40, (ii) if the Test Date Condition is not satisfied and the Total Payments as of the Test Date are equal to or greater than 50% of the Funded Amount, 1.65, and (iii) if the Test Date Condition is not satisfied and the Total Payments as of the Test Date are less than 50% of the Funded Amount, 1.75.

If the Purchasers have not received Total Payments equal to the then-applicable Cap Amount as of the 10th anniversary of the Closing Date (or, if no products of the Company have been approved by the FDA or EMA on or before the Test Date, the 8th anniversary of the Closing Date), the Issuer will be obligated to pay to the Purchasers an amount equal to the Cap Amount less the Total Payments made as of such date.

paragraphs: Biohaven 為一間生技製藥公司，專注於免疫學、神經科學與腫瘤學等關鍵治療領域，發現、開發及商業化改變生命的治療方案。我們正在推進創新治療藥物組合，運用我們已證實的藥物開發經驗與多種專利藥物開發平台。

2022 年 10 月 3 日，Biohaven Pharmaceutical Holding Company Ltd.（"前母公司"）完成向其普通股股東發放所有我們現有普通股股份，並從前母公司分拆出 Biohaven Ltd.（"分拆"）。因應分拆，Biohaven 於 2022 年 10 月 3 日成為一間獨立且公開上市的公司，並於 2022 年 10 月 4 日在紐約證券交易所以 "BHVN" 編碼開始正常交易。

2025 年第四季，我們啟動戰略組合與成本優化措施，以優先發展三個關鍵、晚期臨牀階段的治療計畫，我們認為這些計畫有最大的價值創造潛力。我們的關鍵臨牀計畫包括 Kv7 離子通道調節用於癲癇；分子降解外在蛋白質（"MoDE"）與針對性去除異常蛋白質（"TRAP"）外在蛋白質降解用於免疫疾病；以及肌肉生成素-活化素路徑靶向藥物用於神經肌肉與代謝疾病，包括肥胖（ collectively, the "key programs"）。下圖的產品候選藥物總結了我們最進展的計畫，包括關鍵臨牀階段的計畫與一些開始進展至臨牀的前期研究計畫。
下表總結了我們產品候選藥物的計畫。我們擁有幾乎所有產品候選藥物的全球權利。

Biohaven 分子降解外在蛋白質（"MoDE"）與針對性去除異常蛋白質（"TRAP"™）降解劑，利用選擇性、快速性與患者友善的自用給藥方式，去除體內致病蛋白質，潛在治療多種疾病。每一個 MoDE 或 TRAP 降解劑為一種新型雙特異性分子，針對特定形式的致病循環蛋白質，並導向肝臟進行內體/溶酶體途徑降解。作為臨牀首個外在蛋白質降解劑，三個 MoDE 與 TRAP 降解劑已於一期臨牀試驗中給予受試者。我們的領先 MoDE，BHV-1300，在一期臨牀試驗中已顯示 IgG 降低超過 80%，並正在開發為專利皮下給藥配方，搭配自動注射器以方便自用給藥。第一個格雷夫斯氏症患者接受 BHV-1300 治療的數據顯示，完全抑制針對 TSH 受體的自體抗體，並在給藥一個月內使 T3 與 T4 正常化。我們計畫於 2026 年啟動關鍵性試驗。

BHV-1400，為 Biohaven 的第一個 TRAP 分子，設計用以專門針對 IgAN 的致病驅動因子，即缺乏半乳糖的 IgA1（Gd-IgA1），而不抑制健康的免疫系統。BHV-1400 已於正常健康志工的臨牀一期試驗中給予受試者，並持續於 IgAN 患者擴展族羣中給予受試者，計畫於 2026 年啟動 IgAN 患者的關鍵性試驗。來自 BHV-1400 最低劑量族羣的數據顯示，與 IgA 腎病領域的競爭對手相比，有明顯差異，於數小時內即深度且快速降低 Gd-IgA1，並保留宿主免疫球蛋白（"Ig"）包括 IgG、IgA、IgE 與 IgM。這些結果已在首個 IgAN 患者接受 BHV-1400 治療後重現，並在給藥一個月內觀察到血尿、蛋白尿與 eGFR 的改善。

BHV-1300 在一期臨牀試驗中已顯示 IgG1、2 與 4 深度降低，並正在開發為專利皮下給藥配方，搭配自動注射器以方便自用給藥。BHV-1300 理性設計以保留 IgG3，潛在允許宿主防禦的保存。BHV-1300 正在開發用以治療常見的免疫介導疾病，例如格雷夫斯氏症與類風濕性關節炎（"RA"）。格雷夫斯氏症為一種 IgG1 自體抗體刺激甲狀腺產生過多甲狀腺激素的疾病。針對性去除致病 IgG 有潛力消除病原性甲狀腺刺激抗體並改變疾病。格雷夫斯氏症估計全球影響 1% 的人口。RA 為一種慢性自身免疫疾病，估計影響全球 1 到 2% 的人口。RA 主要影響關節，導致疼痛、腫脹、僵硬與功能喪失。
我們評估 BHV-1300 單劑與多劑的影響於食蟹猴。2023 年 9 月，我們報告確認性研究的數據，顯示單劑後兩天 IgG 水平降低 75-80%，三劑後 IgG 降低超過 90%。

FcRn抑制劑在開始單劑或多次劑量後約7至21天內，最大降低幅度為60-80%，在食蟹猴中觀察到。相較之下，單劑BHV-1300在約2天後可降低IgG約75至80%，在三次快速劑量後降低幅度超過90%。BHV-1300的顯著暴露時間約為一個劑量間隔內，與FcRn抑制劑所需的持續暴露時間相比。FcRn抑制劑在動物和人類中觀察到的與機制相關的風險，包括低白蛋白血癥和高膽固醇血癥，並未預期且不會在食蟹猴中發生於BHV-1300。請參閱下方比較BHV-1300與FcRn抑制劑降低速度與深度的圖表。
2024年1月，我們報告了BHV-1300的預臨牀藥效單劑數據，顯示Biohaven的IgG降解技術允許與含Fc的生物製劑同時使用。在BHV-1300劑量後12小時給予Humira®，其藥動學未受影響（請參閱下方圖表）。
* 獨家改編自BLA 761154, IND 116471, 研究編號r-fkb327-01 我們的BHV-1300第一期研究

BHV-1300在健康受試者中的第一期單劑研究（SAD）於2024年第一季啟動。2024年5月，我們報告了BHV-1300第一期研究的初步結果。這些結果顯示，在已完成的前四組受試者中，BHV-1300能以劑量依賴方式快速且選擇性地降低IgG（請參閱下方圖表）。初步的IgG降低數據與模型預測一致，即使在初始低劑量組中也觀察到劑量和時間依賴性的IgG降低。部分受試者觀察到IgG降低至基線值的50至70%。BHV-1300在降低IgG的同時，未顯著影響LFTs、白蛋白、LDL膽固醇或其他血液檢查。BHV-1300至今已顯示安全且耐受良好，無嚴重或重度不良事件。大多數不良事件（"AEs"）為輕微，被認為與研究藥物無關且自然恢復。如預期般，由於分子對IgG的選擇性，與安慰劑相比，在劑量後一週內平均IgA、IgM或IgE水平未見顯著降低。未觀察到生命徵象或心電圖的不良趨勢。模型預測第一期研究中進一步的組別將能使用與皮下注射相容的劑量，達到超過70%的IgG降低。
第一期研究也比較了BHV-1300的靜脈注射與皮下注射。皮下注射的BHV-1300顯示平均約44%更高的預期暴露量，與劑量相當的靜脈注射製劑相比，且無注射部位反應。這項新的人體數據確認了我們以方便劑量方式使用BHV-1300的計畫可行性，包括患者自用的皮下自動注射器。

2024年第四季，我們更新了BHV-1300的第一期研究，報告皮下注射的BHV-1300達成針對IgG（IgG1、IgG2、IgG4，超過IgG3）的深度降低，在持續劑量研究中測試的最低皮下劑量下，降低幅度超過60%。在持續劑量研究（MAD）中，皮下注射的BHV-1300在每次週期劑量後數小時內逐漸降低IgG，藥效效果在四週研究期間相對於基線持續。BHV-1300在第一期研究中已顯示安全且耐受良好。未觀察到對白蛋白或肝功能的臨牀顯著影響，也未觀察到膽固醇增加。進一步強化競爭性安全性表現，且如設計所預期，研究週期第4週末的血漿IgG3水平得以維持，以允許健康的免疫效應功能。所有AE為輕微，任何與藥物相關的AE均已解決，且無因研究藥物相關AE而中止研究。在MAD中的優化皮下製劑也顯示與先前報告的靜脈注射BHV-1300相比，患者間變異性顯著降低。此外，我們宣佈已與Ypsomed簽訂協議，開發及製造BHV-1300的易用自動注射器，供自用並用於商業化。

paragraphs: 您應閱讀下列對我們財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析，並與本年度報表（Form 10-K）中其他處所出現之財務明細表及相關附註一併參考。有關 2023 年項目及 2024 年 12 月 31 日結止年度與 2023 年結止年度之間之年度比較，若未包含於本 Form 10-K 中，可於本年度報表（Form 10-K）中「第 7 項 管理層對財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析」部分找到。除歷史資訊外，本討論與分析包含風險、不確定性及假設之預測性陳述。我們實際結果可能與這些預測性陳述所預期者有重大差異，原因在於某些因素。我們在本報告中討論可能導致或促成這些差異的因素，包括於「第 1A 項 風險因素」及「預測性陳述警示」部分所列者。

我們是一家專注於免疫學、神經科學及腫瘤學等關鍵治療領域，從事發現、開發及商業化改變生命的治療方案之生物製藥公司。我們正在推進創新治療藥物組合，運用我們已證實的藥物開發經驗及多種專利藥物開發平台。在 2025 年第四季，我們啟動了一項戰略重新優先順序，現已聚焦於三個關鍵領域以優先配置資源。我們的關鍵臨牀計畫包括 Kv7 離子通道調節用於癲癇；分子降解外在蛋白質（"MoDE"）及針對異常蛋白質之目標去除（"TRAP"）外在蛋白質降解用於免疫性疾病；以及針對肌肉生成素-活化素路徑之藥物用於神經肌肉及代謝疾病，包括肥胖（ collectively, the "key programs"）。
有關我們計畫之完整討論，包括最新發展，請參閱本年度報表（Form 10-K）中「第 1 項 事業」部分。
2022 年 10 月 3 日，原母公司完成與 Biohaven Ltd. 之分離。分離後，Biohaven Ltd. 成為一獨立、公開上市之公司，自 2022 年 10 月 3 日起，並於 2022 年 10 月 4 日在紐約證券交易所（NYSE）以符號 "BHVN" 正常交易。
Biohaven 是一間百慕達羣島（"BVI"）公司，分離前為原母公司之 wholly owned subsidiary。
我們已與原母公司簽訂分銷協議及與過渡服務、授權及某些其他事項相關之其他協議。這些協議規範我們與原母公司之關係，包括員工福利、稅務及某些其他負債與義務之分配，這些負債與義務屬分離前、分離時及分離後之期間。有關這些協議之更多資訊，請參閱本年度報表（Form 10-K）中財務明細表附註之「第 14 項 關聯交易」。
以下為影響我們業務於 2025 年之關鍵發展摘要（不包括我們計畫之更新，有關計畫之更新請參閱本年度報表（Form 10-K）中「第 1 項 事業」部分）：

2025 年 4 月 28 日（"成交日"），本公司及部分子公司與 Biohaven Therapeutics Ltd.（"發行方"）、本公司及部分子公司（"負債方"）、購入方（"購入方"）及 Beetlejuice SA LLC（"購入方代理"）簽訂了貸款購買協議（"貸款購買協議"或"NPA"）。根據貸款購買協議，購入方同意從發行方購買高階有擔保貸款（i）在成交日後不久，於滿足某些慣常成交條件後，以總計 250 百萬美元（"第一筆貸款"）購入，以及（ii）在滿足某些條件後，包括取得美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）對 troriluzole 之批准，於 2026 年 6 月 30 日前最多分三次購入，總計 150 百萬美元（"第二筆貸款"）。第一筆貸款及第二筆貸款之銷售所得可用於營運資金及允許之業務用途。發行方亦可選擇在取得購入方同意參與之批准後，於其獨自裁量下，最多分四次以總計 200 百萬美元（"第三筆貸款"及與第一筆貸款及第二筆貸款合稱"貸款"）出售給購入方，其所得僅可用於資金
允許的收購及相關成本與費用。本公司於2025年4月從第一期債券的銷售中獲得約250 百萬美元的資金。

購入方將有權獲得支付（稱為「收入款項」），初始為6.25%的全球淨銷售額（「淨銷售額」），若購入任何第二期債券，則此比例將按比例增加。若於2030年12月31日（稱為「測試日」）時，收入款項（若troriluzole已獲得FDA核准）與任何里程碑款項（如下所定）總額等於或高於購入方支付給發行方的總購入金額（稱為「總購入金額」），則後續年度的收入款項比例將自動減少60%。若測試日條件未達成，則後續年度的收入款項比例將自動增加至較低者，即（i）自成交日至測試日適用的利率，使購入方在測試日時可獲得總購入金額的100%，以及（ii）80%。收入款項將自成交日後每季支付一次給購入方。
發行方亦有義務支付購入方里程碑款項（稱為「里程碑款項」），該款項為總購入金額的35%，於troriluzole或其他本公司產品獲得FDA或歐洲藥物管理局（「EMA」）核准時支付。里程碑款項將自核准後的下一季開始以均等季度分期付款，若里程碑款項是在測試日後獲得，則於核准後的第10個營業日以單筆支付。
除了上述的收入款項與里程碑款項外，若測試日條件未達成，則本公司有義務向購入方支付一次性的款項，金額為測試日時總購入金額的100%，扣除至測試日時已支付給購入方的收入款項與里程碑款項總額（稱為「調整款項」）。若troriluzole在測試日時尚未獲得FDA核准用於治療強迫症或脊髓小腦性協調失調，則任何里程碑款項在計算調整款項時將被排除。

購入方有權獲得收入款項之權利，將在購入方已收到收入款項與里程碑款項（稱為「總款項」），加上發行方支付的調整款項總額等於當時適用的上限金額時終止，除非在該日期前已終止債券購入協議。『上限金額』指總購入金額乘以（x）在測試日或測試日條件達成前的較早日期，針對第二期債券為1.65，針對第一期債券及任何第三期債券為1.95；以及（y）在測試日或測試日條件達成後，（a）針對第一期債券及第三期債券，（i）若測試日條件達成，為1.60；（ii）若測試日條件未達成且測試日時總款項等於或高於總購入金額的90%，為1.80；（iii）若測試日條件未達成且測試日時總款項低於90%但等於或高於總購入金額的50%，為1.95；（iv）若測試日條件未達成且測試日時總款項低於總購入金額的50%，則在成交日後的第8個紀念日為2.10，若在第8個紀念日後則為2.25；（b）針對第二期債券，（i）若測試日條件達成，為1.40；（ii）若測試日條件未達成且測試日時總款項等於或高於總購入金額的50%，為1.65；（iii）若測試日條件未達成且測試日時總款項低於總購入金額的50%，為1.75。
若在成交日後的第10個紀念日（若在測試日時本公司任何產品尚未獲得FDA或EMA核准，則為第8個紀念日），購入方尚未收到等於當時適用上限金額的總款項，發行方有義務支付給購入方的金額為上限金額減去截至該日期已支付的總款項。

paragraphs: 就任何與本公司證券有關之投資決策，您應謹慎考量下列所列風險，以及總體經濟與商業風險，以及本年度報告表10-K及本公司其他向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）所提交之文件中之其他資訊。上述任何事件或情況之發生，或其他不利事件，可能會對本公司之業務、營運結果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響，並可能導致本公司普通股之交易價格下跌。此外，尚有其他風險或不確定性，目前尚未為本公司所知或本公司認為不重要，亦可能對本公司業務造成損害。
投資本公司普通股將面臨若干風險，包括與本公司產品候選藥物相關之風險、與本公司業務相關之風險，以及與本公司普通股相關之風險。下列風險因素清單並非完整，請閱讀本節標題為「1A. 風險因素」之資訊，以獲得更詳細之說明。
•本公司之營運歷史有限，自成立以來已產生重大營運虧損，並預期在可預見之未來，仍將持續產生重大營運虧損。
•美國及全球總體經濟條件惡化，包括長期通貨膨脹對本公司供應商、第三方服務提供者及潛在合作夥伴之影響，可能對本公司之業務與營運結果產生負面影響。
•若無法在需要時以對本公司有利之條件籌措資金，將迫使本公司縮減預定之營運與成長策略。
•本公司投資或存放資金之金融機構之信用風險，可能對本公司造成不利影響。
